bio.text: Ramon Mora Jr. is an independent candidate for New Jersey's 2nd Congressional District, where Republican Jeff Van Drew is the incumbent.
Mora, 32, lives in Vineland and has worked as a nurse technician.
He said he was on track to become a registered nurse until a back injury from a motorcycle crash, and that he has no formal political experience.

sources.title: New Jersey election 2026: What to know about the 2nd Congressional District race
